0.original: Varshahn stares at the floor despondently.

26.original: Fill the leakproof container with ceruleum at the ceruleum spring.

27.original: Deliver the ceruleum-filled tank to the designated location.

48.original: If Cagnazzo's intent was for his parting words to give us pause, then he has succeeded.

49.original: To embrace death, to find satisfaction in oblivion... Perhaps it is indeed true that many voidsent yearn to return to the Lifestream.

50.original: Why does he look so defeated? We are closer to finding his sister, are we not?

51.original: The eye explains <hex:021A020203>how<hex:021A020103> they managed to cross over, but we still don't know <hex:021A020203>why<hex:021A020103> they chose this time and this place for an incursion.

52.original: Looking to head back to Lapis Manalis? Just say the word.

54.original: Oh, Azdaja... What has become of you, that even your eye should be so spent of aether...

55.original: I cannot bear the thought of her being held captive a moment longer, but how will I find her? What must I do?

57.original: I appreciate that you are upset, but such passion clouds your judgment. You must endeavor to remain composed.

58.original: When your mind is clear, we may consider how to proceed with our search.

60.original: In the meantime, I will help Alphinaud and Alisaie back at the village.

61.original: That sounds like a fine idea. We should go as well.

63.original: Leave Vrtra be. He needs time alone with his thoughts.

64.original: Let us take comfort in the knowledge that the voidgate is closed, and that the people of Garlemald need fear the voidsent hordes no longer.

65.original: We're to help Alphinaud and Alisaie, are we? There's little else of interest here, so I wouldn't be opposed to the diversion.

66.original: Pray give me a moment longer.

67.original: I don't see Vrtra with you. Is everything all right?

68.original: He needs a moment to himself. While he is indisposed, we thought we'd lend you a hand.

69.original: I've just finished patrolling the area, so we're fine on that front.

70.original: There are no signs of voidsent, and I doubt we'll see any more now that the gate has been closed.

71.original: As for Alphinaud, he's set his sights on the ceruleum spring. We're hoping to take as much of the stuff as the snowcraft can bear.

72.original: That much fuel would keep the people warm for a good while.

73.original: We've managed to procure a few suitable containers for transporting the ceruleum, and were about to return to the spring.

74.original: If you've a mind to scrounge up more containers, I can take what you have now and get them filled.

75.original: Thank you, Estinien. The more we can load into the snowcraft, the better.

76.original: Would you and Y'shtola mind helping us with our search, then?

77.original: You'll need to take any suitable containers to the spring, and then back to the snowcraft once you've filled them with ceruleum.

79.original: Hmmm, will this be solid enough?

80.original: It is a welcome change to have Zero helping of her own volition. Perhaps she is finally beginning to trust us.

81.original: This is less a container and more a sieve, given its poor condition and visible holes...

82.original: The container appears to be well suited for repurposing. It would be a fine choice for ceruleum storage.

83.original: We just need to carry this liquid fire to the snowcraft? Sounds simple enough.

84.original: The container is now filled to the brim with ceruleum.

85.original: If that one has been filled, you should hurry and take it to the snowcraft.

86.original: Estinien has already seen to the rest.

87.original: Go on ahead. The others asked that I remain here in the event they find more.

88.original: Good work, my friend. I expect we'll have a sizable load to deliver.

89.original: The snowcraft is all but overflowing with ceruleum containers. However, several of your comrades have yet to arrive. Perhaps a nearby vantage point will afford you a more favorable view of their return.

90.original: It was good seeing you again. I hope you'll remember to call on us sooner the next time you need help.

91.original: Vrtra has quelled the tempest within his heart. He should be fine.

92.original: That Azdaja's eye hasn't succumbed to Darkness bespeaks her incredible resilience.

93.original: So let us trust in this sign that she yet lives, and be not deterred in our efforts.

94.original: I'm not your keeper, nor do I know what you expect of me. But I will keep my word.

95.original: I must apologize for my bout of melancholy. To be so easily shaken ill becomes a great wyrm.

96.original: You have remained at my side and ever offered me support and encouragement. I haven't the words to thank you.

97.original: I suppose this is where we part ways for now.

98.original: Though we have every faith in you, we will pray for your safety all the same.

99.original: I'm glad we had the chance to talk, Zero. Take care, and till next time!
